invite.subject: Invitation to Groscove Ultra: {scope}
invite.body: You have been invited to join Groscove Ultra as {role} at {scope}.
invite.expires: The link is valid for {days} days and only works with this e-mail.
invite.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, ignore this message.
invite.signature: Groscove Ultra · the bridge between brands and creators

work.prefs: You get this e-mail because e-mail notices are on in Groscove Ultra. To turn them off, go to Profile → Notifications.
work.signature: Groscove Ultra · the bridge between brands and creators

opportunity_received.subject: New opportunity: {brand}
opportunity_received.body: {brand} has an opportunity for you in {deal}. See the offer and reply in the app.

opportunity_updated.subject: {status, select, counter_accepted {Counteroffer accepted} other {Counteroffer declined}}: {deal}
opportunity_updated.body: {status, select, counter_accepted {The agency accepted your counteroffer in {deal}.} other {The agency answered your counteroffer in {deal} and did not accept it. See why in the app.}}

deliverable_decided.subject: Changes requested: {deal}
deliverable_decided.body: Changes were requested on your deliverable for {deal}. See the comment and send the new version.

deliverable_submitted.subject: Deliverable waiting for you: {deal}
deliverable_submitted.body: {talent} sent a deliverable for {deal}. It is waiting for your approval.

contract_acceptance_requested.subject: Terms to sign: {deal}
contract_acceptance_requested.body: The terms for {deal} are ready. Read and sign in the app with your full name and CPF/CNPJ.

task_due_soon.subject: Deadline coming up: {deal}
task_due_soon.body: A task in {deal} is due in less than 24 hours ({date}).

sponsorship_published.subject: Sponsorship opportunity: {title}
sponsorship_published.body: The agency is offering a moment from {talent} for your brand to sponsor: {title}. Reply by {date}.

sponsorship_interest.subject: {brand} wants to sponsor: {title}
sponsorship_interest.body: {brand} replied “I want to sponsor” on {title}. Read the message and decide in the app.

sponsorship_decided.subject: {status, select, won {Your brand was chosen} sponsored {Sponsorship confirmed} cancelled {Opportunity cancelled} other {Opportunity closed}}: {title}
sponsorship_decided.body: {status, select, won {The agency chose your brand to sponsor {title}. Continue in the campaign in the app.} sponsored {{title} was sponsored by {brand}.} cancelled {The agency cancelled the opportunity {title}.} other {The agency closed the opportunity {title}.}}
